name: Appraisal Letter Edge - Invalid Year Rejected
goal: Verify that the bot rejects an invalid year (e.g. 1800) for the appraisal letter and prompts for a valid year.

phases.description: User asks for their appraisal letter.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot asks for which year the user wants the appraisal letter.

phases.description: User provides an invalid year like 1800.
phases.completionCriteria: The bot indicates the year is invalid or data is not found, and prompts the user again or guides them.
